subject: Post-call: Rate limits & overage pricing — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Rate limits & overage pricing — next steps

Hi Alex — great to connect earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call on the rate limits / overage pricing front.

Call recap
- Current observed monthly usage (prod): ~500–700M tokens/month.
- Acme forecast: ramp to ~3–5B tokens/month over the next 9–12 months as the personalization feature rolls out.
- Burst profile: short spikes up to ~2k QPS for ~10–20 minutes during marketing pushes.
- Primary asks: predictable unit cost for planning, clear burst/quota rules, and a procurement-friendly SOW.

Pricing/Unit economics we discussed
- Your stated target: ~$150–$200 per 1M tokens as a target blended unit cost.
- For budgeting, you said the initial FY target for token spend is in the $400k–$1.2M range depending on adoption speed.

Redwood options we proposed
1) Reserved base commit + overage: base monthly commit with discounted unit rate, plus overage at an agreed per-1M rate.
2) Burst allowance: short-duration bursts can be accommodated without immediate quota change using our burst buffer; sustained bursts require a quota increase.
3) Pilot: 3-month pilot with a blended pilot rate and an option to convert to reserved capacity after ramp.

Open questions / what we need from you
- Please confirm a target blended $/1M tokens you can sign up to for a pilot (you mentioned ~$180 on the call as a target).
- Can you share the expected steady-state monthly average and a conservative peak QPS number (we have what you said on the call but prefer a formal number for the SOW)?
- Procurement contacts and any PO/contracting requirements (templates, ACH vs wire, procurement timeline).

Next steps (proposed)
- I’ll draft a short SOW + pricing summary and share it with you and procurement by EOD tomorrow. (Attached: initial pricing sheet + SOW stub.)
- Rafael and I will propose a pilot structure (3 months, commit + capped overage) and include explicit burst handling language.
- Schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week to review SOW and signatures.

If the budget band and ~180 $/1M target sounds right, say the word and we’ll build the SOW around that.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments:
- redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing bands & examples)
- SOW-draft-v2.pdf (SOW stub; placeholder terms)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Rate limits & overage pricing — next steps

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed steady-state: planning for ~600M tokens/month initially, expect to grow to ~3B within 9 months if the pilot goes well.
- Peak/burst detail: during campaign spikes we see ~1800–2200 QPS sustained for short windows (~10–25 minutes). These are the critical events to support without throttling.
- Budget: our procurement team prefers to target ~$180 per 1M tokens as a planning figure; upper bound we can justify in the $220 range with clear ROI.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com handles contracts. Our standard requirement: 30–45 day net payment, an insurance clause, and a standard Data Processing Addendum.

Ask: can you include explicit language in the SOW about burst allowances (we need at least 30 minutes/month of burst buffer at no overage for campaign testing) and a straightforward quota increase path (who to contact, SLAs for quota increases during onboarding)? Also please include an example calculation so our finance team can see monthly spend vs usage.

If you can send the SOW + example invoice by tomorrow, we’ll route to procurement and finance.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | (212) 555-7421

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: Rate limits & overage pricing — internal pricing notes

Internal — quick thoughts on approach for ACME-4472: 

1) Pilot pricing proposal:
- 3-month pilot: guaranteed base commit = 150M tokens/month at $160 per 1M
- Overage during pilot: $220 per 1M above commit, with a cap on monthly overage equivalent to 200% of commit (we can negotiate).
- Burst buffer: provide 30 minutes/month of unharmed burst handling (up to 2.5k QPS) for campaign testing. Beyond that, overages apply.

2) Production conversion:
- If they convert to reserved capacity within 90 days, convert pilot volume to a 12-month commit at a discounted $/1M (example: $145 per 1M for 1–3B tier).
- Quota increase SLA: standard 48–72 hrs for quota requests; expedited SLA (4–8 hrs) available for customers on dedicated contracts (requires Finance approval).

3) Commercials to watch
- Blended target $180/1M is reasonable to accept for entry given expected LTV; but need to cap pilot downside with overage caps.
- Legal will want explicit DPA and indemnity language; procurement terms (net 30) are ok but push for net 45 only for enterprise commit.

I’ll attach a cleaned pricing sheet and a short SOW template for Marissa to send. Rafael

Attachments (internal): redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Rate limits & overage pricing — next steps

Alex / Procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the internal notes above, here’s what we can do and the next steps: 

What we’ll include in the SOW (attached)
- Pilot: 3 months, base commit 150M tokens/month. Blended pilot rate: $160 per 1M tokens for the committed volume.
- Overage: $220 per 1M during the pilot, capped at 200% of monthly commit (example calculations included in the pricing sheet).
- Burst handling: we’ll include a 30-minute/month burst buffer (up to 2.5k QPS) at no charge for campaign testing. Sustained bursts beyond that will be billed as overage unless a quota increase is requested.
- Quota increases: request via support@redwood.ai with SLA of 48–72 hrs for onboarding; expedited 4–8 hr path available once we have a signed reserved agreement.
- Billing: draft provides Net 30 payment by default; we can accommodate Net 45 for a 12-month commit.
- Compliance: DPA and SOC 2 language included as standard; legal team can iterate with your procurement.

Attached: SOW-draft-v2.pdf, redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx, usage-export.csv (sample usage showing peak windows). I’ve also added example monthly invoice calculations in the pricing sheet so finance can see projected spend at different adoption levels.

Proposed next steps
- Procurement sync: 30 min on Fri 10/9 or Tue 10/13 — which works for your team?
- Please confirm you’re comfortable with the pilot structure and the ~$160 pilot blended rate (and the $220 overage cap) so Rafael and I can finalize commercial terms.

Happy to hop on a call if either procurement or finance want to walk through the invoice examples.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
